feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: Global temperature: October 2026 was the warmest October on record at 1.75 °C above pre-industrial
entry.summary: Copernicus puts the October global air temperature at 15.35 °C, 0.90 °C above the 1991–2020 average and above the 2023 record. — Sources: Copernicus Climate Change Service, surface air temperature for October 2026

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, rose to 32 centimetres on 12 November, double the reading of the day before
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 32 centimetres at 06:15 on 12 November, up from 16 centimetres on 11 November and 15 centimetres on 10 November. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, readings of 8 to 12 November 2026

entry.title: Queensland, Australia: severe to extreme heatwave conditions continue in the Peninsula through the weekend
entry.summary: The Bureau of Meteorology warning of 12 November puts highs in the high 30s to low 40s °C and lows in the mid to high 20s °C. Conditions in the Gulf Country are severe to extreme and easing. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Queensland heatwave warning IDQ21013, issued 12 November 2026

entry.title: Maricopa County, Arizona, has confirmed 511 heat-related deaths in 2026, 81 more than in all of 2025
entry.summary: More than 200 further cases are under investigation, and the 2023 record of 645 deaths could be passed. The counts are preliminary until the medical examiner closes each case. — Sources: Maricopa County Public Health, heat deaths surveillance report, week ending 31 October 2026 · AZFamily, 4 November 2026, citing Maricopa County figures

entry.title: Indonesia counted 425,167 haze-related respiratory infections from 20 August to 5 November
entry.summary: The health ministry's figures include 184,018 cases in children aged nine and under. Air-quality data for 3 November placed two districts in the hazardous band and 15 in the unhealthy band. — Sources: The Star, 9 November 2026, citing Indonesia's health ministry · Indonesia Ministry of Health, via InfoPublik, 2 to 3 November 2026
